title_original: Chris Pratt to Star in Sci-Fi Family Drama ‘The Traveler,’ Inks First-Look Producing Deal at Paramount (EXCLUSIVE)

blocks.text: Chris Pratt is setting up his next sci-fi adventure: starring in Paramount Pictures ‘ big-screen adaptation of “The Traveler,” based on the novel by Joseph Eckert.
The film is part of the new first-look, three-year producing deal Pratt inked at the studio through his Indivisible Productions banner. Pratt will potentially star in select projects.

Eckert’s “The Traveler” tells the story of a reluctant time-traveler and his son, and “the bond between them that even millennia cannot break.” A synopsis of the story describes it as “an adventure full of heartbreak, hope, and futures beyond imagination.” Zach Lipovsky and Adam Stein will direct “The Traveler,” based on a screenplay by Justin Rhodes. The film will be produced by Adam Rosenberg and Jules Daly.
Additional projects under Pratt’s deal include “Miami Heat,” written by Brad Copeland (“Jerry & Marge Go Large”), with Pratt set to star and produce alongside Hutch Parker (“Venom: The Last Dance”).
